title: Chapter 60: The Lords’ Choice
content:
Chapter 60: The Lords’ Choice

Wu Qing saw that the four most important lords, Hu Wei, Shi Gan, Yu Chong and Bai Yan, did not communicate with others, but just looked at each other, without any special eyes or movements.

Although Meng had some confidence, he was not absolutely sure whether these four territories would join the territories.

Wu Qing felt that the possibility of these four territories joining the alliance was very high because these four territories had strength.

The alliance was hastily established with only three so-called purposes, and in the end it still had to speak based on strength. No matter how high-sounding Meng's words were, its essence was still the law of the jungle, which was common in that world.

Territories without strength could only hope that the alliance would not be too ugly and give everyone a way to survive. They now had very little room for choice.

Either they would be destroyed by the mopping-up troops of the evil god camp, or they would join the Tengu clan and become cannon fodder that would not last forever.

The alliance to be established today gave them a new choice. Although it was unknown, there was still a glimmer of hope.

Meng's reputation in these independent territories is indeed good. Many lords are willing to believe in him. With Meng in the alliance, they have some expectations.

Wu Qing's way of dealing with people, plus the performance of the Zerg in the past few days and their identity background, are also plus points for the alliance.

Until now, there has been no clear opposition on the field.

Meng ate and drank a lot, giving everyone enough time to think and discuss.

When he finished the meat on the table, a lord stood up and took the initiative to express his position.

"My wild boar leader is willing to join the alliance!"

This is a pig lord. The fat man has a black pig head with fangs on his body. He was the first to stand up and express his support for Meng.

The pig tribe is a large tribe among the local races. They have a particularly strong reproductive ability, strong survival adaptability, and a large population.

Ordinary pigs do not have fangs. After their strength is improved, they can evolve into tusk pigs. The elite troops composed of tusk pigs are one of the important forces for the local camp to fight against the evil god camp.

"Haha! Great! The alliance welcomes the Wild Boar Lord to join!"

"From now on, we will be allies who share hardships and happiness!"

Meng laughed happily when he saw someone taking the lead in joining the alliance.

With someone taking the lead, other lords stood up and expressed their willingness to join the alliance.

In an instant, most of the lords present expressed their opinions, and the lords who had not made a decision seemed a little embarrassed.

Wu Qing saw that the four lords did not express their opinions, and they were still sitting there steadily without moving.

"Haha, good, good! We will have the oath ceremony later!"

Meng waited for a while, and when he saw that no one stood up to express their opinions, he stared at the four lords and scanned them back and forth.

"What do you four think?"

Faced with Meng's question, Hu Wei stood up with a smile, stroked his white beard, and said with a smile: "I, Hu Jiaqiu, will definitely join the alliance with Lord Meng and Lord Wu Qing!"

"The reason why I have not expressed my opinion is that I don't want to affect the choices of other territories."

"Since Lord Meng has come to ask in person, then I will express my opinion on behalf of Hu Jiaqiu. We want to join the alliance!"

Hu Wei said very straightforwardly that he would join the alliance, and also explained why he did not express his opinion first.

What he said does make sense. These powerful territories have not decided whether to join. The territories that have expressed their intention to join the alliance now are either those territories that have certain confidence in the future of the alliance, or those territories that are really desperate.

In Hu Wei's view, the former has a certain vision, and the latter is a territory that the alliance can really trust. Both are available.

He will look down on the territories that choose to join after he expresses his opinion. Of course, the other three territories are not counted.

Before joining the alliance, this method was used to identify the territory. Hu Wei was indeed the leader of the fox territory and one of the most intelligent people in the region.

He said this deliberately to see how other territories would choose. This was another identification process.

He remembered the performance of these territories and would use them in the future.

Smart people like Meng and Wu Qing could analyze the desired information through their behavior without his special reminder.

"Hahaha! Good! With the addition of Hu Jiaqiu, the power of the alliance will be even stronger!"

Meng seemed very happy and turned his eyes to Shi Gan.

Shi Gan stood up slowly.

"After careful consideration, we, Black Stone Castle, chose to join the alliance."

Shi Gan spoke slowly and expressed his choice.

After saying this, he stopped talking.

"Good!"

Meng smiled happily and looked at Yu Chong again.

Yu Chong stood up with a smile and said, "I am very happy to witness so many independent territories choose to unite and fight against foreign enemies together!"

"As a member of this place, what reason do I have to choose to be alone?"

"So, Wutongzhai Territory and I choose to join the alliance and contribute a little to the development and growth of the alliance!"

"Haha, Yu Chong, I knew you would join!"

Meng seemed to be very familiar with Yu Chong. When he was happy, he called him by name directly without even adding the word "lord".

Meng grinned and said to Bai Yan with a smile on his face: "Lord Bai Yan, what about your Bailangyuan?"

Bai Yan had a cold wolf face and said in a deep voice: "We Bailangyuan joined!"

"I hope that when our alliance contributes enough, the alliance can help us do something!"

Bai Yan was the first person to make a request to the alliance, but he first expressed his willingness to join, and he mentioned the condition that the alliance had made enough contributions. Once he said this, he seemed very open and aboveboard.

"Of course, no problem! As long as we are members of our alliance, it is our duty to help each other without harming the interests of the alliance!"

Meng solemnly promised Bai Yan, and also made a promise to all the territories that chose to join the alliance.

After Bai Yan's statement, Meng no longer asked other territories individually, but put away his smile and said seriously: "What are the choices of other territories?"

"If you choose not to join the alliance, then after this meal, please go back!"

"Next, it is our joining ceremony and the meeting of the alliance. It is not convenient for you to participate!"

Meng was directly driving away the guests.

Those who do not join the alliance can go back now. This is considered to have fulfilled his promise and fulfilled the purpose of the alliance. The alliance is free to come and go.

With Hu Wei's words just now, the remaining lords who wanted to see the situation first became a little restless.

These people are fence-sitters, always wanting to see which way the wind blows before making a decision. Now that they have met Hu Wei, who is a tough guy, they are a little embarrassed.

However, several lords still stood up and expressed their willingness to join the alliance.

The remaining dozen lords all chose not to join the alliance for their own reasons.

Meng waited for a while, and seeing that no one spoke, he said to the guests: "Lords who do not join the alliance, please go back!"

At this time, a ratman lord who chose not to join the alliance stood up and shouted: "Wait! I have something to say!"
